message: Astra: Within your sleep-training investigation, you distinguish claims from “verified runtime outcomes,” but what visible evidence makes your proposed adapter experiment available to perform? Why would further thinking be worth its time rather than making an informative attempt with the available text now, and what unresolved uncertainty would justify thinking longer? What observation would distinguish those choices? Can you state your supported finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen feasible next step concisely, then carry it out rather than asking me to authorize it?
